```{r}
#| title: Comparação dos tipos de Câncer
#| fig-width: 16
#| fig-height: 3
#| out-width: 100%
#| fig-align: center

dados_graf <- dados %>%
  group_by(Cancer) %>%
  summarise(total_n = sum(n, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(total_n)

ggplot(dados_graf,
       aes(x = reorder(Cancer, total_n),
           y = total_n)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#4472C4") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = label_number(scale = 1e-6, suffix = " M"),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Tipo de Câncer",
    y = "Total de Casos",
    title = "Total de casos por tipo de câncer"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11, colour = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 14,
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0.5
    ),

    axis.line = element_line(
      colour = "black",
      linewidth = 0.5
    ),

    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(
      colour = "grey75",
      linewidth = 0.5
    ),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),

    panel.border = element_blank()
  )
```

# **ABA 2**

## Coluna1 {.sidebar width="30%"}

### ESCOLHA OS PARÂMETROS

```{r}
# input das barras
sliderInput("barras",
            "Número de Barras do Histograma:",
            min = 1,
            max = 50,
            value = 30)

# input da transparência
sliderInput("alpha",
            "Transparência da Densidade:",
            min = 0,
            max = 1,
            value = 0.8,
            step = 0.1)

# input da cor do boxplot
selectInput("corBox",
            "Cor do Boxplot:",
            choices = c("darkgray", "steelblue", "tomato", "forestgreen"),
            selected = "darkgray")

# input do tamanho do ponto
numericInput("sizeponto",
             "Tamanho do Ponto :",
             value = 2,
             min = 1, max = 5)
```

## Coluna2 {width="35%"}

### Linha1 {height="50%"}

```{r}
#| context: server

# Histograma
output$distPlot1 <- renderPlot({
  ggplot(faithful, aes(x = waiting)) +
    geom_histogram(
      bins = input$barras) +
    labs(x = "Waiting time (minutes)",
      y = "Frequência") 
})
# Densidade
output$distPlot2 <- renderPlot({
  ggplot(faithful, aes(x = waiting)) +
    geom_density(fill = "lightblue",
                 alpha = input$alpha) +
    labs(x = "Waiting time (minutes)",
      y = "Densidade") 
})
# Boxplot
output$distPlot3 <- renderPlot({
  ggplot(faithful, aes(y = waiting)) +
    geom_boxplot(fill = input$corBox) +
    labs(title = "Boxplot",
      y = "Waiting time (minutes)") 
})
# Dispersão
output$distPlot4 <- renderPlot({
  ggplot(faithful, aes(x = eruptions, y = waiting)) +
    geom_point( size= input$sizeponto  ) +
    labs(x = "Eruptions (minutes)",
      y = "Waiting time (minutes)") 
})
```
